library_preparation_preflight.summary: Spring Boot 4.0.0 moved actuator health support (HealthContributor, HealthIndicator, Health, CompositeHealthContributorConfiguration) out of spring-boot-actuator/-autoconfigure into a new sibling artifact org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-health, which spring-boot-actuator-autoconfigure no longer pulls in transitively (confirmed via its Gradle module metadata), causing the javac 'package does not exist' failures.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Update carried-over test imports: org.springframework.boot.actuate.health.{Health,HealthContributor,HealthIndicator} moved to org.springframework.boot.health.contributor.{Health,HealthContributor,HealthIndicator}; org.springframework.boot.actuate.autoconfigure.health.CompositeHealthContributorConfiguration moved to org.springframework.boot.health.autoconfigure.contributor.CompositeHealthContributorConfiguration. Also review user-code-filter.json: the includeClasses rule for org.springframework.boot.actuate.autoconfigure.** won't match the new org.springframework.boot.health.autoconfigure.** package, so health-related reachability entries may need that package added to be captured.
risks: spring-boot-health's own API surface (e.g. package/class names beyond what's verified here) may have further differences between 4.0.0 and later 4.x releases worth re-checking if a later version's compile also fails.

Other actuator-autoconfigure areas beyond health (metrics/observability, since spring-boot-starter-actuator also pulls spring-boot-starter-micrometer-metrics) may have similar module splits in 4.0.0 not covered by this specific issue.
